_note: Final thesis item F3 - AS/RS design data. Values = DESIGN values or REFERENCE ESTIMATES (catalogue mid values). Formulas = guide docs/31 section 17 (checked there), generalised. Tool: asrs_design.py. Guide: Doctor paper/60_final_asrs.md.

crate._note: steel crate (box pallet, EN 13626 style) 1200 deep x 800 to the aisle, forklift + fork entry on the 800 side; one crate standard for castings and machined parts

_ppc_note: castings / forgings / blanks per crate (layers with separators); R01: RB50 8, RB100 6, RB150 4 handled by mass limit in the program
_fill_note: machined parts need dunnage -> 75 % of the raw count per crate

stock._note: RAW max stock = lot + safety (foundry delivers weekly); KIT max = avg + safety; kitting: one kit trolley per 30 units, each needs ~10 crate visits at the pick station (crane out + back)

rack._note: single-deep, double-sided, one aisle; clearances EN 15620 class 400; beam / upright from docs/31 §17 (simplified EN 15512 style - final design by the rack supplier with tested sections)
rack._height_note: high-bay section: 14.0 m clear under the lowest roof member; 1.5 m top clearance for the top guide-rail cross ties (13.35 m, part A drawings), sprinklers and lighting

crane._note: single-mast stacker crane (EN 528); masses: docs/31 §17 (mast mass computed from its section and height)
crane._rail_note: rail 50x30 flat bar; effective contact width b - 2r = 50 - 2x4 = 42 mm for the wheel-load check (DIN 15070 / FEM 1.001 style, as docs/31)

cost._note: REFERENCE ESTIMATES for the option comparison only; real offers from AS/RS suppliers
